answer: Ask any master what his trade fears most and he will name the same thing: a man who can copy the mark but never learned the craft. Cabinetmaker bench book with cabinetmakers attestation is the defence against that man: ten-year book, 900 pieces built, veneer accounts, quarterly audit. Pass off work under a stolen ridge and the work is condemned, the seller pays the buyer twice the price and the ember is seized by the wardens, while the kernel is entered in the book and shown to the next court.
